book.name: Isáysa
book.title: Isáysarini kuku Nuw Isáysi yuwaa Apanll kamanirangu anoo kamanchintspa

content: Apanll Taarashipani nuwaa, Shiy Isáysaa, patumbchee yáyarush, anush, Maher-salal-hasbasa átush yandangcha.
Anoo yandayarush, tputsee kamanipaneem nachungangcha, tárangiya. Nuwsha tputsee nachungaranguri, Uriyasa, misha Sakáriyas, Jeberikiyasarini wipa nuw parangina.
Anumunsha, izanllpati maaranguri, izanlli nlluraa mireeyaru, kamuzaa iparinarangiya. Izanlli Apanllee kamanimapanitamcha. Apanllsha nuwaa, Ipareetsish Maher-salal-hasbas ísamangcha.

Ndatuma iparish, Apaa, misha Ataa, táru, arapich tputs Síriypat, misha Efrayinpatatam waratchinllinaya. Yaktaa Damáskoo, misha Samariyaatstam kasikchusin, pangoo ichingaru kapeeteersin, maachiritaa izuuru yachinllinaya. Urkireetstam ichingchinllinaya, Apanll nuwaa tárangiya.

content.text: Kung Silowepaz ashirus apinll naantar ashkus taaksa.
Siy Resínaa, misha Pékaatstam punirangus, Asiriyshuchpa amikurtarangsa.
Yuwamand siy Asiriyshuchpa tputs amikurtarangis anumand,
Apanll siyaa waneekchu, kung Eufratis ashiru kumbiyaru,
Asiriyshuch urkar wasundururpat zapan siyash kuskatssin, siyaa uru kasichinllinaya. Kung wingoo putaru sheersin,
Kungpaz ashiru kumbiyaru, Utaáshuchee watsapun izuuru puchiya.
Tputsee wayarpunumun tutsipchiya. Ashkachu, kiyung kachiychinllinaya.
Asiriyshuch tputs ashikpaz sheeru, izuuru siyaa kasichinllinaya.
Aparich kurak ateeja. Shaniyeerus, nuwaa kuki mazinangtsa.
Pinasakitaatis, itaru watam Emanowel iyapa taakuwa;
iyaa kapung istakuwa, siy uru taachpasa,

content: Ashiriya, punirintspa, nuw Isáysi siyaa atashina, watam Apanll iyaa ksutkuwa.
Apanllsha Taarashipan kuweetsi kizpur patsisayaru, Utaáchchish tputs tchitinllpa; an tamaparee ashiru chinarinllpa, nuwaa tárangiya.
Piyartach tputs, Amikurtayani, atitaatssin, itaru siysa Utaáchchis anoo chinarintspa. Tputs nllitarit kizpur puniktaateesinaya, itaru siynaa punirintspa.
Apanlleetsimari puningtsa, watam wamari kizpur taakuwa. Apanlleetsimari chinangtsa, nuw siyaa atashina. Apanll chiyaa napku, ¿chakaja tasasach?

Watam Apanll siyaa ksutkuwa. Itaru, Apanllimunari xarashish taariya. Xarakchus, izuuru pantsaksa. Siy Utaáchchis, misha Efrayinshuchitamtis Apanllimun patumbchimunpaz ashiru xarakus, pantsaksa. Ashkus, Irusarinshuchtam ashpari pantsachinllinaya.
¿Tputs wanipaja pantsaksin, tsipakana? Ashirucha, Apanlleetsimari punimaam waritakiya, nuw Isáysi siyaa atashina.

content.text: Nuw ipunsheetsi tárangina. Siy nuwaa kuki mbizarintspa.
Akoparinchichee tputs tsiyantarangu, uwshtisin Apanllee kuk payumaam pinasaranganaya.
Ashiritaa, nuw urutamari Apanllimun mangi tatkina.
Taarashipan nuwaa ipusarangiya Israelchichee mangoo p'tsimaama.
Apanll nuwaa ipari wayarangiya Irusarinshuchee tpuxtamaama.
Itaru, ayam Israelchichisha tputs siyaa táchinlliniya.
Uru chiy tputsich kchit taakuch, kanizee mashamaam chinakaniya wasina yasamaama.
nuw siyaa atina. ¿Antaati nguti áti? nda. Siyaa zurampatari uru táchapsiniya.
Atitaatssin, itaru anoo mazinarintspa, watam mangshari ashiru atanawa.
Yuw tputs atana an kiyung kachiychinllinaya.

footnotes.text: Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Utaáshucheema 2.13 tayusima kamankiya.
